breaking_changes: Express 4.9/body-parser 1.9/send 0.12 to current major versions may affect middleware ordering, routing behavior, request parsing defaults, and static/file response APIs.
MongoDB driver 2.x to 7.x changes connection APIs, cursor behavior, callbacks/promises, ObjectID/ObjectId usage, and supported Node versions.
Socket.IO/socket.io-client 1.x to 4.x changes protocol compatibility, server/client options, middleware/auth patterns, and event connection handling.
jsonwebtoken 5.x to 9.x changes supported algorithms, validation defaults, and Node runtime requirements; socketio-jwt is legacy integration code.
winston 1.x to 3.x removes old transport/logger APIs; winston-logstash and gc-stats are deprecated or no longer maintained.
request is deprecated; replacing or upgrading consumers affects callback request flows and error handling.
sharp 0.14 to 0.35 changes native install/runtime requirements and image operation behavior.
uuid 2.x to 14.x changes module entry points and v4 import/call style.
csv 0.4 to 6.x, xmlbuilder 2.x to 15.x, archiver 0.14 to 8.x, and fluent-ffmpeg rc/deprecated packages may affect admin ingest/export/media code.
risk_summary.notes: Primary language is JavaScript/Node.js. Package manager is npm. Build/runtime entry points include tv-radio-frontend/app.js, tv-radio-frontend/app-media.js, tv-radio-admin/Admin/API/app.js, tv-radio-admin/CLI/chapman.js, tv-radio-admin/Export/primo-export.js, tv-radio-admin/Ingest/ingest.js, tv-radio-admin/Search/build.js, and tv-radio-admin/Utilities/ember-precompile.js. No npm lockfiles were discovered in the manifest scan.

coverage_notes: GitNexus repository tv-radio was available and indexed, but Cypher IMPORTS lookup returned no JavaScript require edges, so line-aware dependency usage locations were collected with rg/targeted line scans. Registry latest versions were checked with npm view on 2026-06-26. Vendored browser bundles under Admin/Interface/libs and frontend static/libs were excluded from usage findings; package manifests were included as configuration findings.
